message: Follow-up source-only review of corrective revision. Do not edit or run any tests/models/providers/native/network/Git. Original v1 batch and your first review are immutable. New source code-examples/swiftui/media-shared-v2/MediaSelection.swift, ReviewRegressionTests.swift, and media-{ios,macos,tvos}-v2/evaluation/*.prompt.md/*.rubric.md. Your P1 stale Off and P2 forced->Off findings were independently reproduced by native tests against unchanged v1 source: /private/tmp/swiftui-review-first-repro/result.json (all three assertion failures exactly matched). New bindings capture generation/item for nil and nonnil; selected unmapped option has an explicit Current display tag; old pending completion notices item change; SwiftUI task key includes store identity. Explicit external item reload remains documented (no auto native observation). Cancellation contract narrowed: Task.cancel is cooperative/eventual; explicit store.cancel is immediate and tested before loader resumed. New prompt starters remove form/generation scaffolding and explicitly request tests; harmless extra invalidation accepted and excluded from grading assertions. Review correction efficacy and new risks, not counts. Report original finding IDs closed within scope vs still open, plus concrete new defects. Automatic external observation and immediate noncooperative task cleanup are deliberate non-goals; do not treat their documented absence as a bug. New three-platform native campaign is running and not yet claimed passed. I am preparing candidate mechanics/preservation checks separately. Return exact final source review for retention; not human acceptance or model-lift evidence.
